title: MOTION (NAZARIAN - PARK) relative to funding to support LANI’s ongoing community beautification and sidewalk improvement services within Council District…
text:
[Council File 26-1545; CD 2]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (NAZARIAN - PARK) relative to funding to support LANI’s ongoing community beautification and sidewalk improvement services within Council District Two (CD 2).
Recommendation(s) for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $1,000,000 in the AB1290 Fund No. 53P, Account No. 281202 (CO2 Redevelopment Projects - Services) to the Board of Public Works Fund No. 100/74, Account No. 3040 (Contractual Services), for community beautification and sidewalk improvement services to be provided by Los Angeles Neighborhood Initiative (LANI) in Council District 2.
2. INSTRUCT and AUTHORIZE the Board of Public Works to prepare, process and execute the necessary documents with and/or payments to the Los Angeles Neighborhood Initiative, or any other agency or organization, as appropriate, utilizing the above amount, for the above purpose, subject to the approval of the City Attorney as to form.
3. AUTHORIZE the Board of Public Works to make any corrections, clarifications, or revisions to the above instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically, or by any other means.
